claims.text: Tower Bridge is a spectacular combined bascule and suspension bridge that was built between 1886 and 1894.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: It was originally constructed to connect East London's rapidly growing population while still allowing shipping to access the Pool of London.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The bridge spans a massive 940 feet in length and features twin towers that each stand exactly 65 metres tall.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: To allow ships to pass underneath, the massive central bascules were originally raised using a hydraulically powered system.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: In 1972, this original operating mechanism was modernized and converted into an electro-hydraulic system.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Because it is so iconic, tourists frequently confuse it with the nearby London Bridge, which sits just 0.5 miles upstream.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: In fact, this confusion is the source of a famous urban legend that an American accidentally purchased the wrong bridge.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Today, visitors can actually explore the twin towers, the high-level walkways, and the original Victorian engine rooms as part of the Tower Bridge Exhibition.
claims.subject: self
